statement: For the audited generalized-Kato theorem family, a root-facing analytic-to-arithmetic composition needs exact complex analytic rank two to force both Selmer dimension two and a nonzero localization direction transverse to kappa_p(E), without assuming equivalent-strength arithmetic information.
reusable_scope: Search-control only: when a proposed rank-two carrier lies in a strict local kernel but its nonvanishing theorem requires ambient localization nonvanishing, separate carrier construction from the transverse local witness before composing toward the root.
difference_from_prior: This sharpens the already known A1a2 localization residual; it is not counted as a new retained obstruction family.
